# Launch photography

These 21 images were generated with the Porter Metrics image studio on 6 Sep 2026 as
placeholders until real photos of Ruhh's bakes are available. They are hosted
permanently by Porter and referenced from `supabase/seed.sql`. Replace any of them
from **Admin → Menu** (per item) or **Admin → Settings** (hero and about).

Click a link to open the image.
